name: Yomogi Seiji
source:
While traveling, he becomes involved in the plane crash and, like Kokoro, is one of the survivors. He possesses an abundance of emergency survival knowledge.

Due to his keen insight, he took on the role of group leader, but he is continuously hindered by the actions of some of its more assertively individualistic members.
